Summary: [Setup] Create private repo Fullstack_Codebloggs and add all coaches as collaborators
Description: Done immediately on repo creation. Branch: main (default).

Summary: [Setup] Create dev branch from main
Description: All feature work branches off dev, never off main.

Summary: [Setup] Create DOCS branch from dev
Description: All shared documentation tasks (wireframe analysis, ai-spec, README) live here.

Summary: [Setup] Protect main branch - no direct commits allowed
Description: Configure branch protection so all merges to main go through dev only.

Summary: [Setup] Initialize Node/Express backend folder structure
Description: Empty backend: server.js, routes/, controllers/, models/, database/. Branch: feature/backend-config.

Summary: [Setup] Initialize React frontend with React Bootstrap and Redux
Description: Install react-bootstrap, redux, redux-thunk, react-router-dom, react-use-cookie. Branch: feature/layout.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Create wireframe-analysis.md on DOCS branch
Description: Both developers contribute. Must be fully completed before any coding begins.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Analyze Login/Registration wireframe
Description: Answer: data needed from backend? Actions triggered? Document POST /session and POST /users with params and sample responses.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Analyze Main Page / Post Modal wireframe
Description: Document GET /users/:id for header display and POST /posts for modal submit. Include sample responses.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Analyze Home wireframe
Description: Document GET /user/:id, GET /posts, PATCH /posts/:id (like), POST /comments. Include sample responses.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Analyze Bloggs wireframe
Description: Document GET /posts (all users sorted desc) and GET /comments?post_id=. Include sample responses.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Analyze Network wireframe
Description: Document GET /users (all) and GET /posts?user_id= (latest post per user). Include sample responses.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Analyze Admin wireframe
Description: No dynamic data for module 9 (cards are under construction). Document restricted access logic.

Summary: [Docs | Wireframe] Team sign-off: agree on all API contracts before coding begins
Description: Both developers must approve every endpoint path, params, and response shape before writing any code.

Summary: [Docs | AI Spec] Create ai/ai-spec.md - global project AI specification
Description: Covers: project identity, scope, architecture, repo structure, allowed tech, coding conventions, definition of done. DOCS branch.

Summary: [Docs | AI Spec] Team review and finalize ai-spec.md before feature work begins
Description: Both developers read and agree. This file is included in every AI prompt going forward.

Summary: [Backend | Config] Create ai/features/configuration.feature.md
Description: Feature goal, scope, requirements, interfaces, acceptance criteria. Used with ai-spec.md when prompting AI.

Summary: [Backend | Config] Add all required backend dependencies to package.json
Description: Includes: express, mongoose, cors, bcrypt, nodemon, dotenv, cookie-parser.

Summary: [Backend | Config] Create database/connection.js with MongoDB connection
Description: Uses MONGO_URI from .env. Exports the connection. Handles connection errors.

Summary: [Backend | Config] Configure server.js with middleware, CORS, and port
Description: Imports express, cors, cookie-parser, connection. Sets up JSON body parsing. Reads PORT from .env.

Summary: [Backend | Config] Create route files for users, sessions, posts, comments
Description: Each file in routes/. Each route imports its controller and defines path + HTTP method + controller method.

Summary: [Backend | Config] Import and register all route files in server.js
Description: server.js must app.use() all four route files with correct base paths (/users, /session, /posts, /comments).

Summary: [Backend | Schemas] Create ai/features/schemas.feature.md
Description: Document all four schemas with field names, types, validations, and relationships.

Summary: [Backend | Schemas] Create User schema in models/User.js
Description: Fields: first_name, last_name, email (unique), password (hashed), birthday, status (String or Boolean), auth_level (default: basic).

Summary: [Backend | Schemas] Create Session schema in models/Session.js
Description: Fields: user_id (ref User), token (String), created_at, expiry.

Summary: [Backend | Schemas] Create Post schema in models/Post.js
Description: Fields: user_id (ref User), title, content, likes (Number default 0), created_at.

Summary: [Backend | Schemas] Create Comment schema in models/Comment.js
Description: Fields: user_id (ref User), post_id (ref Post), content, created_at.

Summary: [Backend | Schemas] Verify all 4 schemas create MongoDB collections on first use
Description: Start server and confirm Users, Sessions, Posts, Comments collections appear in MongoDB.

Summary: [Backend | Session API] Create ai/features/session-endpoint.feature.md
Description: Scope: login, logout, session validation. Include user flow, expected inputs/outputs, acceptance criteria.

Summary: [Backend | Session API] POST /session - Login endpoint
Description: Accepts email + password. Finds user, compares bcrypt hash. Creates session token, stores in Session collection, returns token in cookie.

Summary: [Backend | Session API] DELETE /session - Logout endpoint
Description: Clears session from Session collection and clears the cookie. Returns 200 with success message.

Summary: [Backend | Session API] GET /session/validate - Session validation endpoint
Description: Reads session token from cookie. Checks Session collection. Verifies token is not expired. Returns user data or 401.

Summary: [Backend | Session API] Test all /session endpoints in Postman
Description: Login happy path, wrong password, logout, validate valid token, validate expired/missing token.

Summary: [Backend | User API] Create ai/features/user-endpoint.feature.md
Description: Scope: create user, get by ID, get all. Include validations and expected responses.

Summary: [Backend | User API] POST /users - Create user (registration)
Description: Hash password with bcrypt before saving. Set auth_level = 'basic' by default. Return created user (no password in response).

Summary: [Backend | User API] GET /users/:id - Get single user by ID
Description: Returns user document by MongoDB _id. Excludes password. Returns 404 if not found.

Summary: [Backend | User API] GET /users - Get all users
Description: Returns array of all users. Excludes password from each. Returns empty array if none.

Summary: [Backend | User API] Test all /users endpoints in Postman
Description: Register new user, get user by valid ID, get user by invalid ID, get all users.

Summary: [Backend | Post API] Create ai/features/post-endpoint.feature.md
Description: Scope: create post, update post (likes), get all posts. Include sort order and response shape.

Summary: [Backend | Post API] POST /posts - Create new post
Description: Body: user_id, title, content. Saves with created_at timestamp. Returns created post.

Summary: [Backend | Post API] PATCH /posts/:id - Update post by ID
Description: Accepts partial updates. Used primarily to increment likes. Returns updated post.

Summary: [Backend | Post API] GET /posts - Get all posts
Description: Returns all posts sorted by created_at descending. Optionally filterable by user_id query param.

Summary: [Backend | Post API] Test all /posts endpoints in Postman
Description: Create post, like a post (PATCH), get all posts, get posts filtered by user_id.

Summary: [Backend | Comment API] Create ai/features/comment-endpoint.feature.md
Description: Note: checklist has typo 'comment-endpiont' - use correct spelling. Scope: create, update, get all.

Summary: [Backend | Comment API] POST /comments - Create new comment
Description: Body: user_id, post_id, content. Returns created comment with timestamps.

Summary: [Backend | Comment API] PATCH /comments/:id - Update comment by ID
Description: Accepts updated content. Returns updated comment document.

Summary: [Backend | Comment API] GET /comments - Get all comments
Description: Returns all comments. Filterable by post_id query param.

Summary: [Backend | Comment API] Test all /comments endpoints in Postman
Description: Create comment on a post, update content, get all comments, get by post_id.

Summary: [Backend | Postman] Build Postman collection covering all endpoints
Description: Organized by resource (Session, Users, Posts, Comments). All params pre-filled. Must run without modification.

Summary: [Backend | Postman] Export PostmanCollection.json to project root
Description: File must be at ./PostmanCollection.json. Commit on feature/backend-config or dedicated branch.

Summary: [Frontend | Layout] Create ai/features/layout-structure.feature.md
Description: Document layout zones: header top, left sidebar nav, right main content. Public vs protected routes.

Summary: [Frontend | Layout] Set up React Router with protected and public routes
Description: Public: /login, /register. Protected (require valid session): /home, /blogs, /network, /admin.

Summary: [Frontend | Layout] Implement main app shell: Header + Left Sidebar + Content area
Description: Persistent shell rendered on all protected pages. Uses React Bootstrap Grid or Flexbox.

Summary: [Frontend | Layout] Login page renders without header or sidebar
Description: Login route bypasses the main layout shell entirely.

Summary: [Frontend | Layout] Registration page renders without header or sidebar
Description: Register route bypasses the main layout shell entirely.

Summary: [Frontend | Layout] Configure Redux store with redux-thunk middleware
Description: store.js with thunk. Connect Provider in index.js. Create initial reducers: user, alerts, posts.

Summary: [Frontend | Login] Create ai/features/login-page.feature.md
Description: Scope: email + password fields, submit triggers POST /session, redirect on success, link to register.

Summary: [Frontend | Login] Build Login page with email and password fields
Description: React Bootstrap Form. Submit calls POST /session. On success store token and navigate to /home.

Summary: [Frontend | Login] Add 'Not a member? Register Now' link below submit button
Description: Navigates to /register.

Summary: [Frontend | Register] Create ai/features/registration-page.feature.md
Description: Scope: all required fields, birthdate picker, validation errors, default auth_level, link to login.

Summary: [Frontend | Register] Build Registration form with all required fields
Description: Fields: first_name, last_name, email, password, birthday, status. All marked required.

Summary: [Frontend | Register] Add date picker component for birthdate field
Description: Use react-datepicker or HTML input type=date. Not a plain text input.

Summary: [Frontend | Register] Add client-side validation with error messages on invalid submit
Description: Each field shows a clear error message when empty or invalid. Block API call until valid.

Summary: [Frontend | Register] Set auth_level = 'basic' hardcoded in POST /users request body
Description: Never allow the user to set their own auth level.

Summary: [Frontend | Register] Add 'Already a member? Login' link below submit button
Description: Navigates to /login.

Summary: [Frontend | Session] Create ai/features/session-frontend.feature.md
Description: Scope: cookie storage, session check on navigation, login-only-when-no-session, logout redirect.

Summary: [Frontend | Session] Install react-use-cookie and store token in cookie after login
Description: After successful POST /session response, store token using react-use-cookie.

Summary: [Frontend | Session] Check session token on every protected page navigation
Description: Each protected route reads cookie, calls GET /session/validate. Redirects to /login if invalid or missing.

Summary: [Frontend | Session] Redirect to /home if user visits /login with a valid session
Description: Prevent authenticated users from seeing the login page.

Summary: [Frontend | Session] Logout: clear session cookie and redirect to /login
Description: Calls DELETE /session, then clears cookie, then navigates to /login.

Summary: [Frontend | Header] Create ai/features/header.feature.md
Description: Scope: logo, Post button (modal trigger), user dropdown with Account Settings and Logout.

Summary: [Frontend | Header] Build Header with logo, Post button, and user dropdown
Description: Uses CodeBloggs logo asset. Displays logged-in username. Always visible on protected pages.

Summary: [Frontend | Header] Logo click navigates to /home
Description: Wrap logo in React Router Link to /home.

Summary: [Frontend | Header] Post button opens Post Modal as overlay over current page
Description: Triggers modal open state (Redux or lifted state). Modal renders over current content.

Summary: [Frontend | Header] User dropdown: collapsible with Account Settings and Logout options
Description: React Bootstrap Dropdown. Username as toggle label. Two items: Account Settings, Logout.

Summary: [Frontend | Header] Account Settings shows Redux-managed toast (auto-dismiss 5s)
Description: Dispatch alert action: 'Account Settings - coming soon'. Alert auto-dismisses after 5 seconds.

Summary: [Frontend | Header] Logout clears session and navigates to /login
Description: Dispatches logout action: DELETE /session + clear cookie + redirect.

Summary: [Frontend | Navbar] Create ai/features/navbar.feature.md
Description: Scope: 4 nav links, admin-conditional visibility, active link highlight, always visible on main pages.

Summary: [Frontend | Navbar] Build left-side Navbar with Home, Blogs, Network, Admin links
Description: Always visible on all protected pages. Uses React Router NavLink.

Summary: [Frontend | Navbar] Admin link visible only when user auth_level = 'admin'
Description: Read auth_level from Redux store (set at login). Conditionally render Admin NavLink.

Summary: [Frontend | Navbar] Apply active highlight style to current page nav link
Description: Use NavLink activeClassName or style callback against current route.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Create ai/features/home-section.feature.md
Description: Scope: user info panel, post list, likes, comments. Data from GET /users/:id and GET /posts?user_id=.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Build Home page: user info panel (left) and posts list (right)
Description: Two-column layout. Fetches logged-in user data and their posts on mount.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Display user avatar as styled initials graphic
Description: Extract first letter of first_name + last_name. Render in a styled circle using brand colors.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Display total post count for logged-in user
Description: Count posts from GET /posts?user_id= and show as a stat.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Display date of user's last post
Description: Find most recent post's created_at and display formatted date.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Render posts list: each post shows content and post date
Description: Map over user's posts. Each Post component shows title, content, and formatted created_at.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Like button increments count via PATCH /posts/:id
Description: Thumbs-up icon. On click: call PATCH /posts/:id, update like count in local state or Redux.

Summary: [Frontend | Home] Display comments list under each post
Description: Fetch GET /comments?post_id= for each post. Render comments below post content.

Summary: [Frontend | Blogs] Create ai/features/blogs-section.feature.md
Description: Scope: all posts all users sorted desc, comments per post, user initials per post.

Summary: [Frontend | Blogs] Show all posts from all users, most recent first
Description: Fetch GET /posts (no user_id filter). Sort by created_at descending.

Summary: [Frontend | Blogs] Show comments under each post on Blogs page
Description: Same comment fetch pattern as Home. Render below each post.

Summary: [Frontend | Blogs] Display author initials logo on each post
Description: Use cached user data to show initials of each post's author.

Summary: [Frontend | Network] Create ai/features/network-section.feature.md
Description: Scope: list of user cards, each with user info and latest post.

Summary: [Frontend | Network] Build Network page with list of UserCard components
Description: Fetch GET /users on mount. Render one UserCard per user.

Summary: [Frontend | Network] UserCard shows initials, user info, status, and latest post
Description: For each user fetch most recent post (GET /posts?user_id=). Show 'No posts yet' if none.

Summary: [Frontend | Admin] Create ai/features/admin-section.feature.md
Description: Scope: restricted access, User Manager card, Content Manager card (both under construction in module 9).

Summary: [Frontend | Admin] Restrict Admin page to users with auth_level = 'admin'
Description: On Admin route load check Redux store auth_level. Redirect to /home if not admin.

Summary: [Frontend | Admin] User Manager card - show 'Under Construction' alert on interaction
Description: Card renders visually. Any click dispatches Redux alert: 'Coming in Module 10'. Auto-dismiss 5s.

Summary: [Frontend | Admin] Content Manager card - show 'Under Construction' alert on interaction
Description: Same pattern as User Manager card.

Summary: [Frontend | Post Modal] Create ai/features/post-modal.feature.md
Description: Scope: global modal triggered from header, title + content fields, POST /posts on submit, click-outside-to-close.

Summary: [Frontend | Post Modal] Build Post Modal with title input, text area, and Post button
Description: React Bootstrap Modal. Controlled by Redux or top-level state so it is accessible on any page.

Summary: [Frontend | Post Modal] Post Modal available globally on all protected pages
Description: Modal open/close state managed at app level. Header Post button dispatches open action.

Summary: [Frontend | Post Modal] Post button submits POST /posts and closes modal
Description: On success: update posts in Redux store, close modal, reset form fields.

Summary: [Frontend | Post Modal] Clicking outside the modal closes it
Description: React Bootstrap Modal onHide prop handles backdrop click.
